campaign.name: Perfumarte AI Art Direction
campaign.objective: Generate two visually coherent premium campaign images for Special Spicy (RPA), translating its luminous citrus opening, sensual floral-fruity heart and warm spicy woody depth into a sophisticated visual story.

visual_relationship.rule: Both images represent the same Special Spicy (RPA) fragrance identity and olfactive narrative through the same selected botanical, spice, fruit and wood elements, adapted into distinct editorial and surreal compositions.
consistency: same amber, saffron, deep brown and muted green color family
same warm, sensual, mysterious and elegant emotional atmosphere

physical_scale_system.scale_reference: Use the perfume bottle as the physical scale reference for the entire scene.
physical_scale_system.element_scale_rule: Every surrounding ingredient and environmental object must have realistic physical proportions relative to the perfume bottle.
physical_scale_system.relative_scale: Every surrounding ingredient and environmental object must have realistic physical proportions relative to the perfume bottle.
physical_scale_system.artistic_scale_override: Do not create abundance by artificially enlarging ingredients.

fragrance_data.name: Special Spicy (RPA)
fragrance_data.description:
Special Spicy (RPA): un perfume nicho unisex especiado, intenso y elegante

Special Spicy (RPA) es un perfume nicho unisex especiado que combina calidez, dulzura y sofisticación en una fragancia compleja y muy envolvente. Diseñado para amantes de los aromas exclusivos, mezcla especias exóticas con flores delicadas y un fondo amaderado de gran profundidad.

Este perfume nicho unisex especiado destaca por su personalidad única, su elegancia moderna y su estela duradera, ideal para quienes buscan algo diferente y memorable.

 

 

¿A qué huele Special Spicy (RPA)?

Special Spicy (RPA) es un perfume nicho unisex especiado donde la bergamota, el higo, la rosa, el oud y el ámbar gris crean una fragancia cálida, floral y profundamente sofisticada.

Una salida cítrica y luminosa

La fragancia se abre con bergamota, lima y limón, aportando un inicio fresco, chispeante y lleno de energía que equilibra su lado especiado.

Un corazón dulce, floral y elegante

En su evolución aparecen el higo, el jazmín, la rosa y el ylang-ylang, creando un acorde suave, sensual y ligeramente afrutado que aporta gran riqueza olfativa.

Un fondo cálido, especiado y lujoso

El ámbar gris, el azafrán, el oud y el pachulí forman una base intensa, misteriosa y muy sofisticada que deja una estela duradera y adictiva.

olfactive_translation.principle: Translate Special Spicy (RPA) as a tactile progression from luminous bergamot to velvety fig and rose, then into saffron warmth, dark oud and earthy patchouli, while allowing ambergris to appear atmospherically through mineral light, resinous sheen and warm air rather than as a literal object.
selection_rules: Select only the most visually expressive olfactive elements.
Prioritize elements that communicate the fragrance identity.
Do not visually represent every note by default.
Atmospheric notes may be represented through color, texture, material, smoke, light or environment.
Never introduce ingredients that are not supported by the fragrance data.
The selected visual elements must work coherently across both campaign images.

selected_visual_notes.olfactive_role: Luminous citrus opening and energetic freshness.
selected_visual_notes.visual_representation: Several realistically sized bergamot fruits, some whole and some cut, showing textured green-gold rind and pale translucent pulp.
selected_visual_notes.reason: It communicates the fragrance's bright opening and provides a crisp visual counterpoint to the dark woody base.
selected_visual_notes.editorial_use: A controlled cluster at the front-left and a few cut sections near the surface, catching sharp highlights without competing with the bottle.
selected_visual_notes.surreal_use: A compact asymmetrical citrus cluster enters from the lower-left foreground and continues behind the bottle at different depths; a few suspended cut segments act only as restrained accents.
selected_visual_notes.composition_role: Creates the bright entry point and balances the warm, dark materials.

selected_visual_notes.visual_representation: Multiple small figs, whole and naturally split, with muted violet skin, granular ruby interiors and broad matte green leaves.
selected_visual_notes.reason: Fig is one of the most distinctive tactile elements in the description, linking sweetness, softness and sensuality.
selected_visual_notes.editorial_use: A substantial midground grouping to the right of the bottle, with overlapping whole figs, two split figs and leaves forming a soft organic counterweight.
selected_visual_notes.surreal_use: The principal right-side cluster is built from figs and leaves close to the bottle, with foreground figs partially cropped and softly defocused; the cluster extends behind the product without covering it.
selected_visual_notes.composition_role: Provides the main organic mass, tactile richness and soft fruity volume.

selected_visual_notes.visual_representation: Several natural dusty-rose blooms and partially opened petals, realistic in scale, with visible layered petal texture.
selected_visual_notes.reason: Rose gives the composition its refined floral identity and prevents the spicy woods from becoming visually severe.
selected_visual_notes.editorial_use: A compact but controlled rose group behind and slightly left of the bottle, with a few loose petals placed low on the surface for scale and softness.
selected_visual_notes.surreal_use: A dense rose-and-petal cluster occupies the upper-left midground, with stems curving naturally behind the bottle and petals drifting subtly through the depth without forming a geometric ring.
selected_visual_notes.composition_role: Introduces elegance, softness and a controlled organic vertical rhythm.

selected_visual_notes.olfactive_role: Exotic warm spice and luxurious intensity.
selected_visual_notes.visual_representation: Small natural saffron crocus flowers and delicate red saffron threads gathered in a shallow dark ceramic vessel and scattered sparingly.
selected_visual_notes.reason: Saffron is the clearest visual expression of the perfume's spicy, exclusive and luxurious character.
selected_visual_notes.editorial_use: A concentrated foreground-midground accent near the bottle base, with threads and flowers visible in precise detail against dark stone.
selected_visual_notes.surreal_use: Thin saffron threads and a few flowers are integrated into the connecting material structure between the fig and oud clusters, with restrained suspended movement and no clutter.
selected_visual_notes.physical_presence: high in detail, low in bulk
selected_visual_notes.composition_role: Adds preciousness, fine linear texture and a warm red-gold chromatic spark.

selected_visual_notes.visual_representation: Several realistic dark oud wood fragments, slim split pieces and textured chips, with resinous black-brown grain and subtle polished highlights.
selected_visual_notes.reason: Oud anchors the fragrance's sophisticated, intense base and gives the visual story its architectural weight.
selected_visual_notes.editorial_use: A low horizontal group supporting the bottle and extending into the background, never touching or obscuring the label; the wood provides the physical surface transition.
selected_visual_notes.surreal_use: A dominant organic wood structure arcs irregularly from the lower-right foreground behind the bottle toward the upper background, creating continuity between clusters without becoming a ring or artificial ribbon.
selected_visual_notes.composition_role: Builds the enveloping material framework, depth and dark contrast around the bottle.

selected_visual_notes.olfactive_role: Earthy green depth and lasting base.
selected_visual_notes.visual_representation: Generous clusters of real patchouli leaves in varied states, including whole matte leaves, layered stems and a few dried curled leaves.
selected_visual_notes.reason: Patchouli adds the earthy-green dimension needed to connect the citrus, floral and woody elements into one natural environment.
selected_visual_notes.editorial_use: Layered leaf clusters in the foreground and rear plane, especially along the lower edges and behind the wood, with enough open surface to preserve typography space.
selected_visual_notes.surreal_use: Patchouli leaves form irregular breathing boundaries around the lower and lateral clusters, some very close to camera and softly blurred, others extending into the atmospheric background.
selected_visual_notes.composition_role: Connects all selected ingredients through green texture, organic layering and earthy atmosphere.

shared_visual_identity.concept: La cámara de las especias: una arquitectura sensorial de oud oscuro, hojas de patchouli, higo aterciopelado, rosa envejecida y destellos de azafrán, atravesada por la luz fresca de la bergamota.
shared_visual_identity.emotional_goal: Transmitir una elegancia intensa y memorable: primero luminosa y fresca, después dulce y floral, finalmente profunda, especiada y amaderada.
shared_visual_identity.environmental_identity: Un entorno de lujo botánico oscuro, entre gabinete de perfumista y paisaje húmedo de madera, con superficies minerales, aire cálido y una atmósfera ámbar sutil inspirada en el ámbar gris.
visual_anchor_elements: estructura irregular de madera de oud
grupo abundante de higos y hojas
luz lateral ámbar con contraste mineral

editorial_still_life.concept: Bodegón de perfumería nicho sobre piedra mineral oscura: la botella vertical y estable ocupa el centro de una composición rica de bergamota, higo, rosa, azafrán, oud y patchouli, con una lectura clara de luz cítrica hacia profundidad amaderada.

environment.type: gabinete botánico de perfumista sobre superficie mineral
environment.description: Una losa de piedra caliza gris carbón con vetas cálidas sostiene la botella completamente vertical. A la derecha se agrupan higos maduros, hojas y rosas; a la izquierda aparecen bergamotas cortadas y un pequeño recipiente de azafrán. Fragmentos de oud se extienden horizontalmente hacia el fondo, conectados por patchouli en capas.
environment.background_rule: The environment may be a studio wall, architectural setting, elegant interior, natural landscape, stone setting or other appropriate environment depending on the fragrance. Use a dark warm mineral wall with subtle amber haze and no distracting scenery; preserve generous controlled negative space in the upper-left and far-right zones for Spanish typography.

visual_elements: botella exacta plenamente visible y vertical
grupo de bergamotas enteras y cortadas
rosas naturales en tonos rosa empolvado

composition.style: rich layered premium still life with a calm asymmetrical balance
composition.element_density: medium, materially abundant through grouped quantities and layered textures
composition.negative_space: generous controlled negative space in the upper-left and around the typography zones, while ingredient density stays concentrated around the lower and lateral still-life area
composition.depth: clear foreground, midground and background with foreground leaves and bergamot softly detailed, bottle and main ingredients sharply focused, and oud and haze receding into the background
composition.bottle_priority: highest; the bottle is centered slightly right of the vertical midpoint, fully visible, sharply focused, unobstructed and clearly separated from the darker background

materials: velvety fig skin and granular pulp

lighting.style: premium commercial photography with warm directional chiaroscuro
lighting.direction: large soft key light from upper left, narrow warm rim from rear right and gentle frontal fill preserving label readability
lighting.contrast: moderately high, with luminous citrus and bottle highlights against deep wood and mineral shadows

style.primary: elegant editorial serif in warm ivory
style.secondary: refined minimalist sans-serif in muted saffron gold
style.hierarchy: clear and sophisticated, with the perfume name largest and note groups smallest

rules: Typography must occupy only the reserved negative-space areas, primarily upper-left and far-right background.
Typography must never cover the perfume bottle, cap or label.
Text must remain legible against the dark mineral wall.
Do not overload the image with text.

immersive_surreal.concept: La botella suspendida dentro de una corriente orgánica de oud, patchouli e higo: una estructura botánica irregular atraviesa el espacio, mientras la bergamota aporta destellos luminosos y el azafrán activa una energía cálida alrededor del frasco.

environment.description: Un espacio oscuro y tridimensional de aire ámbar, madera resinosa y hojas húmedas. La botella flota cerca del centro visual sobre el eje principal, completamente enfocada y con una inclinación fija de aproximadamente 8 grados: el tapón queda ligeramente desplazado hacia la izquierda y la base hacia la derecha. Masas de ingredientes se acercan a ambos laterales y continúan detrás de la silueta sin cubrir ninguna parte del producto.

visual_elements: botella suspendida con inclinación fija de 8 grados hacia la izquierda en la parte superior
ramas y fragmentos curvos de madera de oud
masas compactas de higos y hojas
bergamotas enteras y cortadas en primer plano
hojas de patchouli en varios planos
niebla mineral ámbar y partículas sutiles

composition.style: rich compact asymmetrical enveloping composition built from organic wood, botanical clusters and atmospheric continuity
composition.element_density: high locally clustered with clear hierarchy; substantial masses near the bottle and smaller accents only where they reinforce depth
composition.depth: physically coherent foreground, midground and background; extreme product focus with medium-shallow falloff on nearby ingredients
composition.bottle_priority: highest; fully visible and recognizable through a dark clean silhouette, controlled rim light, label contrast and sharp focus
composition.negative_space: small irregular breathing areas between material masses; no wide empty halo around the bottle
composition.enveloping_structure: An irregular resinous oud-wood structure begins as a cropped low-right foreground mass, rises behind the bottle in naturally curved split branches and recedes toward the upper-left background. Patchouli stems and leaves bind into the wood, while fig leaves and saffron threads weave through the structure. The continuity is physical and botanical, not a liquid ribbon or geometric enclosure.
primary_clusters: Cluster 1, dominant right side: a dense group of three to four realistic figs, broad patchouli leaves and a few rose blooms close to the bottle's lower-right and mid-right side; it has the greatest organic volume, with front figs cropped by the frame and rear leaves passing behind the bottle silhouette without touching the label.

Cluster 2, lighter left side: several bergamotas whole and cut, two compact roses and sparse saffron flowers positioned close to the bottle's upper-left and lower-left; this cluster is smaller and more luminous, connected to the right cluster by curved oud fragments and drifting saffron threads.

Cluster 3, structural lower background: a heavier bed of dark oud wood pieces and patchouli stems running from the lower-right foreground behind the bottle toward the far-left background; it supplies depth and unequal visual weight rather than forming a symmetrical frame.
composition.foreground_plan: Place a few bergamotas cut at realistic scale very close to the lower-left lens, partially cropped and softly defocused; add overlapping patchouli leaves and a dark oud fragment entering from the lower-right edge. Include one cropped fig and a few rose petals near the bottom margin, all materially integrated with the air and wood rather than floating as isolated objects.
composition.midground_plan: Keep the bottle near the visual centre and in sharp focus. Concentrate the main fig-patchouli mass beside the lower-right silhouette and the bergamot-rose-saffron group beside the upper-left silhouette. Place curved oud branches and stems behind the bottle, close enough to create enclosure but leave the entire cap, glass body and label unobstructed through tonal contrast and focus.
composition.background_plan: Continue the oud branches, patchouli stems and intermittent fig leaves behind the bottle into a dark amber atmospheric background and toward all image edges. Recede the rear clusters through softened focus, mineral haze and warm rim light; maintain material density behind the product so the environment never becomes an empty void.
composition.overlap_plan: Patchouli leaves overlap the bases of figs and partially overlap oud fragments in the foreground. Rose stems pass behind the bottle's left side, while oud branches pass behind both lateral edges without crossing the label. Bergamot pieces overlap a few saffron flowers in the lower-left cluster. All overlaps remain outside the bottle contour, cap and label; no ingredient covers or intersects the product.
composition.negative_space_plan: Use narrow irregular openings between the bergamot cluster and the left bottle edge, between the fig leaves and the right shoulder, and in small pockets within the oud structure. Keep these spaces organic and uneven, filled with faint amber haze; never create a circular clearing or wide empty halo around the bottle.

lighting.style: cinematic commercial lighting with atmospheric chiaroscuro
lighting.direction: strong soft key from upper-left/front, warm rim light from upper-right behind the bottle and subtle low amber bounce from below
lighting.contrast: high enough to separate the bottle and label from the ingredient masses, with controlled luminous highlights on glass, citrus rind and saffron

negative_constraints: no typography in the immersive_surreal image
no wide empty halo around the suspended bottle
no inverted or alternating surreal bottle tilt
no floating bottle in the editorial_still_life image
